description: This file contains the core game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game, including data structures representing game state, and functions for making moves, detecting winners, and resetting the game.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Immutable snapshot of the game board state, including the current player, game over status, winner, and winning line indices.

classes.name: GameEngine
classes.description: Object containing pure functions for managing game logic, such as move execution, winner detection, and game reset.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Returns a new initial game state with an empty board and default values.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Applies a move to the game state at a specified index, returning the new game state with updated board, current player, and game outcome.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner ('X' or 'O') based on the current game board, if any.

methods.name: getWinnerLine
methods.description: Returns the indices of the winning line if a player has won, otherwise null.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks whether the game is a draw (all board positions filled with no winner).
